## About
Brighton Auto YP is a car repair and maintenance shop on South Archer Avenue in Chicago. We work on all makes and models, whether you drive a domestic, Asian or European car, an SUV, a truck or a light commercial vehicle.
We try to explain things clearly and give you honest recommendations, so you know what your car needs and why. Business owners can also ask us about fleet service.
Our customers have given us a 4.4 rating across 220 Google reviews. Give us a call or book online to set up your visit.

## Services
- Brake service: Brake inspections and repairs to keep you stopping safely in Chicago traffic.
- Oil change: Quick, thorough oil change service with synthetic and conventional oils.
- Battery service: Battery testing, replacement and maintenance so your car starts in every Chicago season.
- A/C service and repair: A/C repairs and recharge for comfortable rides through the warm months.
- Vehicle diagnostics: Diagnostics to pinpoint what's going on with your vehicle quickly and accurately.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension repairs for a smoother, safer ride on rough city roads.
- Fleet service: Maintenance and repair options for business owners with work vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models, including domestic, Asian and European cars, SUVs, trucks and light commercial vehicles.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
A: Yes. We provide a warranty on all repair and maintenance work.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Use the online contact form or call the shop directly and we'll set you up.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
